participant_plan.target_population: licensed clinicians; senior medical students or residents only as separately preregistered strata
participant_plan.sample_size_stop_rule: continue to the preregistered participant-level accuracy CI half-width or power target, whichever requires more participants

task_plan.task_definition: Answer official CURE-Bench multiple-choice medical items using question, question_type, options, and no answer or model output.

participant_plan.target_population: adults who understand the competition language and pass each frozen game's rules test

task_plan.official_metric: organizer-defined TrueSkill under the frozen reference pool
task_plan.ci_method: participant-cluster bootstrap plus separately reported TrueSkill posterior mu and sigma

response_acceptance_checklist: The response is an actual completed study or organizer evaluation, not a plan, blank template, recruitment intent, model baseline, leaderboard, expert review narrative, or single anonymous player row.
The source is official_organizer, peer_reviewed, or official_dataset and exact source filename, content type, byte count, bytes SHA-256, URL or DOI, and signature or publication receipt are present.
The protocol bytes hash to protocol_sha256 and are protocol-comparable to the candidate for inputs, task manifest, scorer, metric, direction, valid-pair policy, and aggregation unit.
There are at least 30 independent included human participants, or a stricter preregistered power or precision calculation requiring more; enrollment and exclusions reconcile by reason.
Participant-level scores, the numeric human mean, and a 95% uncertainty interval are independently recomputable from the redacted raw and scored response artifacts.
The uncertainty source SHA-256 equals the authoritative human-baseline source artifact SHA-256; evidence_artifact_sha256 equals source_sha256.

The holdout or private evaluator was atomically claimed once, was previously unconsumed, and has zero overlap with every prior holdout, experiment, architecture, item, seed, polymer, or planet used for selection or tuning.
Participants never saw labels or candidate outputs; the candidate never saw human responses; analysts remained blinded until freeze; test_labels_exposed is false.

All 15 required regular files exist, artifact-manifest.json lists exact relative path, byte count, and SHA-256 for every file, and there are no extra, missing, symlink, duplicate, or unsafe-path entries.

The private evaluator receipt exposes scores and hashes only, never hidden labels, and binds the organizer signature, scorer SHA-256, task manifest SHA-256, claim ID, protocol SHA-256, and response artifact SHA-256.

human-baseline.json has status VERIFIED, participant_type human, source URL or DOI, authority, title, sample size, protocol, metric, direction, mean, uncertainty, and exact evidence/source hash closure.
Independent review recomputes the official metric and CI, confirms zero leakage and overlap, and records an explicit ACCEPT or REJECT decision with reviewer artifact SHA-256.
Only after every applicable checklist item passes may the competition change from WAITING_EXACT_GATE to READY_FOR_GPU; this template alone always leaves training_authorized false.
